title: Flex is a settlement layer with splits up to MAX_SPLITS=5
body: Faremeter Flex (scheme @faremeter/flex) is prepaid escrow on Solana with off-chain authorizations and batched on-chain settlement. The payment authorization carries splits: array of (recipient_token_account, bps) summing to 10000, max 5 entries, max 8 distinct mints per escrow. mergeSplits() collapses duplicate recipients (program rejects FLEX_ERROR__DUPLICATE_SPLIT_RECIPIENT). Faremeter program ID EcfUgNgDXmBx4Xns2qZLE54xpM7V1N6PL8MdDW1syujS.
context: MAX_PENDING=16 concurrent pending settlements per escrow
facilitator submits batched on-chain via submit_authorization, refund window default 150-1296000 slots
client SDK: @faremeter/flex-solana; facilitator helpers: @faremeter/payment-solana/flex/facilitator + @faremeter/flex-solana/facilitator
docs URL pasted by user; canonical at docs.faremeter.xyz/llms.txt

title: Client signs authorization off-chain with session key; facilitator settles
body: Client flow: createEscrow (refund_timeout_slots 150-1.3M, deadman_timeout_slots >= 2*refund), depositInstruction USDC into escrow, generateKey Ed25519 sessionKey, registerSessionKey with revocation_grace_period_slots < refund_timeout_slots. Then @faremeter/payment-solana/flex/client createPaymentHandler binds escrow+mint+sessionKeyPair into a @faremeter/fetch wrap, which signs authorizations on 402.
context: Authorization fields signed: programId, escrow, mint, maxAmount, authorizationId (random u64), expiresAtSlot, splits
Server-side validates Ed25519, recomputes serializePaymentAuthorization, all bound to client signature
Already implemented today as createFlexFacilitator(c.env) per flex-route-helpers.ts line 173

title: createFacilitatorHandler is the plug-in for Faremeter middleware
body: @faremeter/payment-solana/flex/facilitator createFacilitatorHandler(network, rpc, facilitatorSigner, opts) returns FacilitatorHandler with verify/settle/flush. opts.defaultSplits: [{recipient, bps}] is what we'd populate with platform+contributors per skill. The handler runs a background flushIntervalMs (default 5000ms). Replace flex-route-helpers.ts:createFlexFacilitator to feed per-skill splits derived from SkillContributor[].
context: createUptoHandler exposes variable-amount holds: authorize(req) -> maxAmount, handle(req, settle) -> settle(actual). Natural fit for unbrowse paid skills where actual cost <= ceiling
Hold lifecycle: held -> settled -> submitting -> submitted -> finalizing
facilitator's last_activity_slot only updated by submit_authorization + refund, not finalize

title: Three-tier requires Stripe Meter API for the metered overage rail
body: Stripe Meter (replaces deprecated usage_records). Pattern: subscription has a metered price referencing a Meter; backend POSTs /v1/billing/meter_events with {event_name, payload:{stripe_customer_id, value}} on each chargeable execution. Stripe invoices the metered usage at period close. recordUsage in stripe.ts must be wired to billing.meterEvents.create({event_name: 'unbrowse_execute', payload: {stripe_customer_id, value: amount_uc}}). Idempotency key on the meter event = `${user_id}:${execution_id}` so retries don't double-count.
context: Per /stripe-best-practices skill: always use idempotency keys; verify webhook sig (already done in stripe.ts:413); store stripe_customer_id in user record (already in syncStripeDataToUserKV)
Pro $20/mo = recurring flat price; metered overage = separate price line on the same subscription, billed in arrears
subscription.created/updated/deleted webhook events drive granted_uc adjustments on the credits ledger
